lines.speaker: Captain Barnacle
lines.text: Ha HA! The Grand Star! Haven't seen it sparkle like that since I was a wee tadpole. Er, sailor.

lines.speaker: Captain Barnacle
lines.text: Ahoy! Welcome to Bubbleton, finest town on the whole seafloor. Mind your step, everything's a bit bouncy.

lines.speaker: Captain Barnacle
lines.text: Three Star Shards are scattered about: up the Jellyfish Fields, high in the Kelp Forest, and on my old ship past the trench.

lines.speaker: Captain Barnacle
lines.text: Bring 'em home and the Great Bubble in the square will carry you all the way up to the Grand Star!
